entities.name: Johnson Publishing Company
entities.description: Chicago-based Black-owned publishing company (1942-2019); publisher of Negro Digest, Ebony, Jet; owner of Fashion Fair Cosmetics, Ebony Fashion Fair, WJPC; Chapter 7 liquidation 2019-04-09.

claims.claim: Founded November 1942 in Chicago by John H. Johnson (originally Negro Digest Publishing Co.)
claims.evidence: African American Registry; Congressional Record vols. 147/149; Johnson autobiography

claims.claim: Ceased operations via Chapter 7 liquidation filed 2019-04-09 (Case 19-10236, N.D. Ill.), ending 77 years
Sold Ebony and Jet to Clear View Group (Austin TX, Black-owned PE) June 2016; price undisclosed; retained Fashion Fair Cosmetics and photo archive

entities.name: John H. Johnson
entities.description: Founder of Johnson Publishing Company; publisher of Ebony and Jet (1918-01-19 - 2005-08-08).

claims.claim: John H. Johnson (Jan 19 1918, Arkansas City AR - Aug 8 2005, Chicago) founded JPC and led it as publisher/chairman until his death
First African American on Forbes 400 (1982); NAACP Spingarn Medal (1966); Presidential Medal of Freedom (1996); Black Enterprise Entrepreneur of the Decade (1987)

entities.name: WJPC
entities.description: JPC-owned Chicago radio station (1973-1994); first Black-owned radio station in Chicago.

claims.claim: JPC bought WGRT (WJPC) for $1.8M in May 1973 - first Black-owned Chicago radio station; sold December 1994

entities.name: Supreme Liberty Life Insurance Company
entities.description: Black-owned Chicago insurer; John H. Johnson's employer 1936-1943; JPC's first offices inside its building; its policyholder list supplied JPC's first subscribers.

claims.claim: Johnson worked at Supreme Life (office assistant/in-house magazine editor); JPC's first HQ 1942-43 was inside the Supreme Life Building at 3501 S. Parkway; first subscribers came from its policyholder mailing list
claims.evidence: notablebiographies.com; AP obituary; Chicago Landmark Designation Report

entities.name: Johnson Publishing Company Archive
entities.description: Photographic and audiovisual archive of JPC's magazines (~4M images); bought at bankruptcy auction July 2019 for $30M; jointly owned by NMAAHC and Getty Research Institute since 2022-07-28; housed at NMAAHC, Washington DC.

claims.claim: July 2019: consortium of Ford Foundation, J. Paul Getty Trust, MacArthur Foundation, Mellon Foundation bought the archive at auction for $30M (Smithsonian co-purchaser role per Art Newspaper, disputed by Pulitzer's four-foundation account)
2022-07-28: joint ownership transferred to NMAAHC + Getty Research Institute; housed at NMAAHC; Getty committed $30M to digitization; public access target 2029 (provisional)
Extent: 3M+ photo negatives/slides; 983,000 photographs; 166,000 contact sheets; 9,000 A/V recordings incl. Ebony/Jet Showcase TV, Black Achievement Awards, radio segments

entities.name: Eunice W. Johnson
entities.description: JPC secretary-treasurer; named Ebony; created Ebony Fashion Fair (1958); founded Fashion Fair Cosmetics (1973). (1916 - 2010-01-03).

claims.claim: Eunice Walker Johnson (1916 - Jan 3 2010): JPC secretary-treasurer, named Ebony ('thinking of the dark wood'), created the Ebony Fashion Fair, founded Fashion Fair Cosmetics
claims.evidence: Black Enterprise obit 2010-01-04; Essence obit 2010; Delta Sigma Theta release 2010-01-08

claims.claim: Formal co-founder status of JPC
claims.evidence: Black Enterprise obituary calls her co-founder; incorporation records not located

entities.name: Linda Johnson Rice
entities.description: Daughter of John H. and Eunice Johnson; JPC president/COO then CEO (2002-2019); last chairman/CEO.

claims.claim: Became CEO of JPC in 2002; last chairman/CEO through the 2019 bankruptcy

entities.name: Desiree Rogers
entities.description: JPC CEO 2010-2017; former White House Social Secretary (Obama, 2008-2010); co-buyer of Fashion Fair Cosmetics (2019).

claims.claim: Named JPC CEO 2010-08-10; partnered with Linda Johnson Rice to lead the company 2010-2017; co-bought Fashion Fair Cosmetics for $1.85M Nov 2019
